page.layout: Top: running head centred and page number at top right. Below, two round portrait medallions side by side, each with its inscription around the rim (left: HOSIVS / POLON. EPISC.; right: DOCTOR. NAVARRVS. / MAR. AZPIL. / CVETA). Below them one column of running text in two paragraphs. Signature at foot right.

main_text.l: HOSIVS POLON. EPISC.
DOCTOR. NAVARRVS. MAR. AZPIL. CVETA.
STANISLAVS Hosius,Cardinalis Polonus,Episcopus
Vuarmensis, legatus Romani Pontificis, & Præses in Concilio
Tridentino,vir doctissimus, & fidei catholicæ accerrimus pro-
pugnator Scripsit Confessione fidei sæpius impressam & ab au-
ctore nunc demum ita auctā,ut nouū opus videri possit. Hæc est
tanti momenti, ut etiā è Latino in Gallicū idioma conuersa sit
nuperrime à Ioanne de Lauardin. Scripsit præterea de expresso
Dei verbo: Dialogum num calice laicis,& uxores sacerdotibus
permitti fas sit : & plura alia. Viuit adhuc Romæ,cum supradi-
cto Azpilcueta.
MARTINVS ab Azpilcueta doctor Nauarrus, insignis
& literarū cognitione præstās, pietatis obseruatissimus,& iuris
Pontificij cōsultissimus, ita ut in prælegendo & interpretando eo
iure in celebri Academia Corymbricensi, primū locū obtinue-
rit,laudis alienæ minime cupidus: cū dicat in quadam epistola,
huius usurpationem esse veluti notā furti, ut ait Iurisconf. in l.
hæreditatum. §. fin. ff. ad l. falc. Is iam octogenarius, magno stu-
dio & labore proprio, versioni sui Enchiridij siue Manualis Con-
fessariorū & Pœnitentiū, incubuit:cum multi pro sua in Deū &
republica pietate,& in authore beneuolentia, Latinè, Hispané-
que callētes, sacræque Theologiæ & utriusque iuris professores
id præstare vellent, bonāque iam parte prestitissent:verū id non
fecit gloriæ causa, sed ut plenius satisfaceret Reip. Christianæ,
& quā plurimis utriusque Hesperiæ viris,erudita pietate claris,
auctoritate Pontificia Reuerendiss. imo & Cardinalitia dignita-
te illustriss.ad id eū vehementer exortatibus. Scripsit tractatum
de edditibus beneficiorū,super ca. Quicquid 16.q 1.quo docetur
quibus usibus sint impedēdi, & quibus personis dādi aut relin-
quēdi:de finibus humanorū actuū,tractatū:& plures alios libros
ex quibus vir dignitate clarus non mediocrē laudem meretur.

page.notes: Medallion inscriptions set around the portraits, transcribed from the rim. The printed text is set in roman with some italic passages. Doubtful readings: "de edditibus" (the word after "tractatum" is hard to read, could be "de additibus") and "versioni" (final letter uncertain). "propugnato·r" has a dot between the syllables and no space before "Scripsit" in the print; I have written "propugnator Scripsit". Printed "posiit" and "vt", "vsurpationem" and similar long-s or u/v forms are normalised as the rules direct, so "possit" appears in the transcription. Long s shows as f-like in the scan and is read as s throughout.
